data.description:
The deterministic half of v1's definition of done. An automated test that drives the product's own HTTP API through the entire Rule-1 chain — sign up, connect an account, generate a contract, create and finalize and send an invoice, apply a paid webhook, observe paid status — on the local docker-compose stack, with NO external accounts.

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 row C-05 (IN by mandate — v1 definition of done, section 6.1).

DECISION CONTEXT. This cannot run against stripe-mock alone. stripe-mock validates request and response SHAPES against Stripe's OpenAPI spec, but it is stateless and emits no webhooks (docs/strategy/spikes/spike-D1-freelancer-invoicing.md section 1). So this task extends the transport fake introduced by the custody-guard task into a STATEFUL Stripe double: it holds account, customer and invoice state, transitions invoices on finalize/send/pay, and emits correctly signed webhook payloads into the webhook receiver. Where shapes matter, keep validating against stripe-mock; where state matters, use the double. Name the two clearly in the tests, because the honest claim of this task is "our half of the loop is correct against OUR MODEL of Stripe" — and the fidelity of that model is exactly what the test-mode acceptance run exists to check. Overstating this task's guarantee is the failure mode to avoid.

VERIFICATION: the suite runs green from a clean checkout with the network unavailable, and turns red if any single step of the chain regresses.

NOT IN THIS TASK: anything requiring a real Stripe account (the acceptance-run task, which is board-gated); browser or UI automation — this drives the API deliberately, so that it stays runnable while the UI tasks are still gated on AS-30 and so a design stall cannot stall verification; performance or load testing (no capability row — v1 has one user).

Plan written (cto-owen, on Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:79108 loop tick 8). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M1D34P9NGTNK5A0PNPJJH98Z.md, commit be33bca. Branch feat/AS-49-e2e-loop cut from master 8161844, linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-49.

DESIGN. The stateful double is a TRANSPORT function injected at the AS-38 seam (createStripeClient({ transport })), so the real pipeline — custody guard included — runs on every call; it cannot be anything else because baseUrl is an option, never configuration, so the shipped web container cannot be pointed at a double and a separate e2e service would need the knob AS-38 refused. The e2e file boots the app in-process via withServer inside the test service (network_mode: none), same as every route suite and the AS-90 demo; it runs unskipped and identically in test and contract. Files: test/helpers/stripe-double.js (new, <=450 lines: accounts/customers/items/invoices state, nine handlers = the custody allowlist exactly, idempotency-window replay, accumulating amount_due, completeOnboarding/pay/failNth, events signed by its own node:crypto HMAC from per-transition snapshots — never sharing code with the verifier under test; two clocks: signature t is real Date.now, event data times are a fixed model clock so paidAt etc. are committed literals) and test/e2e-loop.test.js (new, <=800 lines, cases E0–E5). harness.test.js list 17->18; README § The suite gains 'The loop half (the stateful double)' with the honest-claim wording verbatim and 'three mock-gated files' -> four. ZERO app source, compose, Dockerfile, demo or dependency-policy change — asserted at review by git diff master -- test/dependency-policy.test.js being empty. Demo SEQUENCE lifted by copy (order, fixed values, request bodies), never by import; demo untouched. Delivery of signed bytes is the test's (loopback POST /webhooks/stripe), never the double's — mirrors the real topology and keeps the double socket-free.

HONEST CLAIM (plan §2, verbatim in three places, pinned as exported STRIPE_DOUBLE_CLAIM): our half of the loop is correct against OUR MODEL of Stripe; stripe-mock validates request SHAPES and answers statelessly, the double holds STATE and validates nothing, neither is Stripe; fidelity of the model is what AS-50 checks. Every case title carries '(STRIPE DOUBLE)'.

CASES / CRITERIA. E0 double table == ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS (cardinality 9). E1 the twelve steps over the API: signup+session; connect start (2 platform calls, row not ready); return not trusted; readiness by PUSH (account.updated -> ok: readiness, syncedAt = event.created) AND by PULL (second return agrees, 2 account reads); client; contract (renderedHtml occurrence counts); draft (zero Stripe calls); finalize (5 connected calls in order, mirror open, amountDue 12500 = total, finalizedAt literal); send (EXACTLY ONE call — the assertion stripe-mock structurally cannot make; then invoice.sent -> ok: fields with sentAt unchanged); paid (ok: applied, paidAt literal); redelivery (ok: duplicate, row deepEqual incl. updatedAt, one ledger row); out-of-order invoice.finalized after paid (ok: stale); whole run 10 calls, every url.origin https://api.stripe.com, 4 platform/6 connected headers, no FORBIDDEN_PARAMS segment in any wire body. E2 transient 502 on the 2nd invoiceitems push, retry completes with 3 calls, 1 replay hit, no duplicate objects. E3 tampered v1 -> 400 applies nothing; wrong-secret double -> 400; then the real one applies. E4 readiness gate inside the loop (403 not-ready, zero connected calls, then ready, then 303). E5 (contract only, skip offline): the double's account/customer/invoice key sets are SUBSETS of stripe-mock's spec-derived fixtures — the model can drift by omission, never by invention. AC-19..21 documentation checks by reviewer grep.

FALSIFIERS (plan §7): 16 recipes, each with an anchor (grep -c = 1), the edit, and the predicted e2e red set (owning-suite reds to be recorded exactly): F1 signup, F2 no connected row, F3 readiness handler, F4 contract clientName, F5 draft Location (anchored to the createDraft line; grep -c 'return detailPath' must read 3), F6 finalize predicate, F7 send predicate, F8 invoice.paid row, F9 recordOnce guard, F10 verifier accepts anything, F10b wrong-secret double, F11 transfer_data in ensureInvoice (guard fires, zero double calls), F12 stale-rank line, F-NET (route one endpoint to the real fetchTransport: 502 network in BOTH services — offline-ness proven by a red), F-ALLOW, F-REPLAY, F-SHAPE, F-V2.

RECEIPTS. Baseline master 8161844 today, -p asc-plan-as49, --build, /usr/local/bin/docker, torn down -v --rmi local: test 420/402/0/18 and contract 420/420/0/0, both 'Image asc-plan-as49-* Built' (log scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/as49/baseline-master.log). Predicted after: test 426/407/0/19, contract 426/426/0/0 (E1 split into per-step cases would raise both by the split count — restate before running).

SEAMS. AS-46 and AS-47 both edit test/harness.test.js (list + V2 literal) — certain, trivial conflict: union the lists, literal = length. README adjacent-hunk possible. AS-46 rewrites routes/invoices.js and routes/clients.js: Location pins at AC-6/8/9/10 are route-table facts, re-checked at rebase, never dereferenced (API only). Merge order AS-46 -> AS-47 -> AS-49; AS-49 may start before AS-46 merges (independent files) and MUST rebase + re-run both receipts before review.

STAFFING. Implementer developer-lena (free once AS-46 clears Ruben's cycle 2; if it comes back for rework she returns to AS-46 first). Reviewer qa-priya (Ruben on AS-46; Priya reviewed the receiver in AS-44 and reads this cold). Tasking rule: give Priya the criteria and the recipe NAMES, never the predicted red sets or the receipt numbers (AS-36). M6 seeds for the orchestrator to hold: a void event after paid (the same-rank conflict), a second freelancer's session against the first's invoice mid-loop.

OPEN (time-boxed, defaults apply): Q1 converge the older per-suite fixtures onto the double — no, this task. Q2 stateful demo variant — no. Q3 dedicated e2e compose service — no (zero compose change is a property). Q4 claim pinned as exported constant + reviewer grep (README is host-only, a test cannot read it in the image). Q5 note for AS-50's planner: E1's committed call order and the double's events are the natural 'expected' column for the acceptance run.

Implementation stage (developer-lena, Opus under the Fable fallback), tick watcher:79108 loop tick 9. Branch feat/AS-49-e2e-loop rebased onto master b091df5 (trivial: no code commits before). Tip a3619a8.

FINDINGS / DEVIATIONS FIRST
1. Case count is +7, not the plan's +6: node --test with no args uses Node's default **/test/**/*.js pattern, so test/helpers/stripe-double.js loads as a zero-case passing 'test' — master already carries test/helpers/auth.js, routes.js and server.js the same way. Case-list diff between the master log and the branch log is exactly E0..E5 plus that one module row. Not a defect; the prediction mechanism was wrong, and every future helper under test/ moves the count by one.
2. AC-2 route-table fact at rebase (plan §9): GET / behind the boundary is the interim 303 -> /connect-stripe (routes/pages.js, until AS-48), not 200. Pinned that; without a cookie 303 -> /signin. The demo's step 2 still expects 200 — demo/run.mjs is out of scope here, noting it for AS-90's next refresh.
3. AC-7: the client name occurs twice in renderedHtml because the demo's fixed projectDescription itself contains 'Northwind Studio'. Asserted as 'once outside the description' (and the description once). Template has one clientName slot — verified, not a defect.
4. AC-14 F-NET red set is WIDER than predicted: E3 also goes red (its seeded-open invoice comes from a real finalize, which hits the mutated endpoint). Explained, recorded.
5. Harness literal is 19 -> 20 (plan said 17 -> 18; AS-46 added two files). dependency-policy.test.js untouched (git diff master -- test/dependency-policy.test.js empty). Zero app-source, compose, Dockerfile, demo change.
6. Double API beyond the plan's list: createAccount() (a model action, so E2-E5 can seed a connected-account row naming an acct_ the double knows — the double refuses to invent state), failNth + failNext alias, stats.replayHits, handled + ALLOWLIST_KEYS for E0's set comparison, now(). AC-20 grep '(STRIPE DOUBLE' reads 8 (6 titles + 2 header-comment mentions); the titles alone read 6.

CARDINALITY
Files: 4 in the diff (test/helpers/stripe-double.js new 422 lines; test/e2e-loop.test.js new 518; test/harness.test.js +1 entry, literal 19->20; apps/invoicing/README.md new subsection 'The loop half (the stateful double)' + 'three' -> 'four' mock-gated files). Cases: E0-E5 = 6 (E5 skips in test, runs in contract). AC-19 grep -c 'OUR MODEL of Stripe' = 1 in each of the three files. Mutants examined: 2 of 16 (box).

RECEIPTS (all --build, /usr/local/bin/docker via node spawnSync, own project names, torn down with --profile tools down -v --rmi local; leak check leaves only Owen's asc-plan-as49-* which I did not touch)
- master b091df5 re-measured from the main checkout: test 451/433/0/18 'Image asc-impl-as49-master-test Built'.
- predicted (written before running): test 457/438/0/19, contract 457/457/0/0.
- observed at a3619a8: test 458/439/0/19 'Image asc-impl-as49-lena-test Built' exit 0; contract 458/458/0/0 'Image asc-impl-as49-lena-contract Built' exit 0, E5 green with the mock's invoice fixture at 75 keys (account 20, customer 22; committed in the assertion message).
Mutants (scratch copy via git archive to /tmp/as49-mut, e2e file only under -p asc-as49-mut, mutation asserted applied at the one site by count, worktree git diff --exit-code clean after):
- F-NET: RED in test — E1 step 9, E2, E3, E4 all 502 StripeTransportError: create-customer; RED in contract — the same four plus E5 (getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN api.stripe.com). Offline-ness proven by observation in both services.
- F-REPLAY: RED E2 only — second finalize 409 AmountMismatchError: reconcile. Exactly as predicted.

NOT READY: 14 of the 16 recipes remain unobserved — F1-F12 (app-source mutants on a scratch copy), F10b, F-ALLOW, F-SHAPE, and F-V2 (I changed the harness before the first run, so its natural red was never observed; needs a scratch run with the list unmodified). Everything else is complete and green; the next tick resumes on this branch at a3619a8 with the mutant battery only. Logs and progress note under scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-49/.

Implementation stage 2 (Lena on Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:79108 loop tick 10) — the remaining mutant battery. FINDINGS FIRST: (1) two mutants red WIDER than plan §7 predicted — F6 and F11 each also take E3, because E3 seeds its open invoice through a real finalize, so any finalize-killing mutant reaches it (the same dependence F-NET showed last tick); same cause, not a guard weakness, no test change. (2) plan-text miscount: the F10b anchor has 6 createStripeDouble(SECRET) sites (E0..E5), not 5; the driver asserts 6 -> 5. (3) F6 and F11 produce the identical 14-case red set (both kill finalize) — noted so the reviewer does not read it as a copy error. No app-source defect surfaced; zero app-source change stands; no test commits this tick. CARDINALITY: 16 recipes in §7; 16 observed red (F-NET, F-REPLAY last tick; F1-F12, F10b, F-ALLOW, F-SHAPE, F-V2 this tick); 0 survivors. METHOD: every mutant on a FRESH git-archive extraction of tip a3619a8 under /tmp/as49-mut/<id> (never the worktree), site-anchored before/after grep counts asserted (F5 anchored to the createDraft line: editPath 2->1, detailPath 2->3; F10b anchored to the E1 title line), FULL test service with --build under its own project asc-impl-as49-mut-<id>, torn down with --profile tools down -v --rmi local; per-mutant diff + red set + messages in scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-49/mutants/<id>.md, driver mutate.mjs. Every run shows 'Image asc-impl-as49-mut-<id>-test Built' and 458 tests. PER-MUTANT RED SETS (test service unless noted): F1 17 fail: E1 step 1 (401 vs 303) + 16 auth/screen cases (A19, H1, H1b, H2-H7, H9, H12-15, two landing cases, S1-ERROR x2, markup-as-text — every one signs up first). F2 3: E1 step 3 (404: updateReadiness on the never-created row) + connect R3, R12; E4 GREEN (narrowness check). F3 3: E1 step 5 + E4 + webhooks W9. F4 5: E1 step 7 + contracts N1, N5, P1, P8. F5 2: E1 step 8 + invoices R2. F6 14: E1 step 9 (409 reconcile) + E2 + E3 + E4 + invoices R6, R9, R10, R11, R12, R13, R15, R22, R25 + invoice-screen send-from-edit. F7 7: E1 step 10 (exactly one call) + invoices R11, R14, R15, R22 + webhooks W17 + send-from-edit. F8 6: E1 step 11 + E3 + webhooks W6, W8, W13, G2. F9 4: E1 step 11b (body not duplicate) + webhooks W5, W6, W13. F10 6: E3 (tampered: 200 ok: applied) + webhooks S3, S4, S10b, W3, W4b. F10b 1: E1 step 5 only (400 SignatureError: verify-signature) — the double's signature is load-bearing. F11 14: E1 step 9 (500 StripeCustodyError: create-invoice) + E2 + E3 + E4 + the same 9 invoices cases + send-from-edit. F12 5: E1 step 12 (body not stale) + repositories I13, I14 + webhooks W6, G3. F-ALLOW 2: E0 (ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS has 10 rows, expected 9) + stripe-client custody-literals case. F-SHAPE: test 458/439/0/19 GREEN (offline half cannot see it); contract 458/457/1/0: E5 only (invoice (draft) emits invented_key). F-V2 1: harness V2 only (expected 19, found 20) — the natural first red. RECEIPTS: tip unchanged a3619a8 (merge-tree against master 305f6fb clean, no rebase needed); closing run on the untouched worktree test 458/439/0/19 'Image asc-impl-as49-lena10-test Built', exit 0, torn down; last tick's contract 458/458/0/0 stands (same tip). Worktree git diff --exit-code clean; /tmp scratch removed; no asc-impl-as49-* images or projects remain; other lanes' projects untouched. WHAT REMAINS: nothing on the implementation side — ready for review (Priya per the plan §11). Reviewer note: AC-21 in the plan says harness lists 18 files; on this master it is 20 (AS-46 added two), recorded last tick.

REVIEW (qa-priya, on Opus under the Fable fallback — my first spawn was refused at HTTP 429). Fresh context: plan, then `git diff master...feat/AS-49-e2e-loop` (tip a3619a8), then README on the branch; Lena's comments read only after my findings were formed. ~25-minute box. Everything ran in my own compose projects with --build; all torn down (`--profile tools down -v --rmi local`, exit 0).

VERDICT: PASS — with one merge-step condition (F1) that the orchestrator must apply by hand, because git will not flag it.

FINDINGS FIRST.

F1 (blocks the MERGE, not the branch — the plan §9 seam, now live). Master has moved under this branch: AS-47 merged (70bcb5b) after Lena's last rebase (b091df5) and her merge-tree (305f6fb). Master's harness.test.js now lists 20 files (contract-screens added, literal 19→20); this branch lists 20 (e2e-loop added, 19→20). `git merge-tree --write-tree master feat/AS-49-e2e-loop` → 6fe3d2132bf17b4b4a674162718d0cb59ef65be8, textually CLEAN — and the merged harness has 21 entries with the literal still at 20 (I read the file out of the merged tree: line 89 `expected exactly 20`, comment still "twenty"). V2 would go red on master immediately after a plain merge. The same silent auto-merge already bit AS-48's rebase this tick (f99eecd). Resolution is exactly the plan §9 wording: union the lists, set the literal to the list's length — 21, comment "twenty-one" — in the merge commit, then take the master receipt. Predicted post-merge: test 468/449/0/19, contract 468/468/0/0 (derivation below). If the orchestrator would rather the branch itself carry the resolution (the plan's "mandatory rebase before review"), that is a one-line implementation-level rework; the branch is correct against its own base and every criterion holds, so I am not sending it back for that.

Residuals outside the list (none block):
R1 — AC-2 deviation, documented: E1 step 2 pins `GET /` with the cookie → 303 `/connect-stripe` (master's interim route in routes/pages.js), not the plan's 200; the property (past the boundary vs to /signin) is what is asserted and the code comment says why. This pin FLIPS when AS-48 merges (its dashboard replaces the interim 303 with a 200) — AS-48's rebase must amend it; Owen's AS-48 plan already records this seam. Carried to AS-48, whose review is mine.
R2 — The double's idempotency window returns the cached reply for a reused key with a DIFFERENT body (my P6 probe; Stripe answers 400 idempotency_error). Consistent with the stated "validates nothing" claim; a candidate hardening for the double if a case ever needs it. Not a criterion.
R3 — E5's subset check is top-level keys + status_transitions only (as the plan asked); nested `requirements.{currently_due,disabled_reason}` and `metadata` are not compared. Note for AS-50's comparison table, not a defect.
R4 — Observed under P1: a `conflict` event IS recorded in stripe_events (recordOnce runs first inside the transaction), so a redelivery of the conflicting event answers `duplicate`, and the error-level log line fires once. That is AS-44's row-iff-processed invariant, by design; AS-50's runbook should know the operator sees a conflict exactly once.
R5 — AC-21's literal "18" is 20 on this master (plan predates AS-46/AS-47); the intent (literal = list length) holds on the branch. Lena's finding stands: node --test runs each test/helpers module as a zero-case pass, so 6 cases add 7 top-level entries (`✔ test/helpers/stripe-double.js`).

M6 PROBES (scratch copy under scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-49/scratch, git-archived from the tip; probe file test/probes-priya.js, never committed; receipt 464/443/2/19 'Image asc-review-as49-priya-probe-test Built' — the 2 reds were my own wrong expectations, below):
P1 void-after-paid (the same-rank seed): hand-built `invoice.voided` from the paid snapshot, re-signed via `events.resign` → 200 `ok: conflict`, mirror row deepEqual to after-paid, event recorded, redelivery → `ok: duplicate`. Mirror image: void on an open invoice → `ok: applied` (status void); then the double pays it and `invoice.paid` arrives → `ok: conflict`, stays void. Rank machine holds in both orders. PASS.
P2 second freelancer's session (the seed): POST /invoices/<id1>/finalize with freelancer 2's cookie → 404, zero double calls, mirror draft; after the owner finalizes, freelancer 2's POST …/send → 404, zero calls, sentAt null; freelancer 2's own finalize still 303. PASS.
P3 valid signature, unknown target: `account.updated` for a double-created acct the app never saw → 200 `ok: unknown-target`, no row; `invoice.paid` for an in_ the app never mirrored → `ok: unknown-target`, not recorded. PASS.
P4 idempotency-window edge: on the E2 retry BOTH item keys are reused (the failed one too — AS-43's stable keys; the double did not cache the 502 so it executed for real). My assertion expected one reused key and aborted there; the byte-identical-body check for both groups did NOT run — not completed, recorded as such. No finding.
P5 signature clock skew: a correct HMAC with t = now−360 s → 400; t = now+360 s → 200 `ok: applied`. By design — signature.js documents a PAST-ONLY tolerance (a container clock running behind must not kill the endpoint; t is inside the signed material so a future t cannot be minted without the secret). t = now−240 s → applied. No finding.
P6 the double refuses what Stripe refuses: second finalize, an item on an open invoice, a connected call for an unknown acct — all 400-shaped StripeApiError through the real client. PASS.

MUTATIONS (scratch copy; anchored replace, count 1→0 / 0→1 asserted, site line printed, --build, restored and byte-compared after):
F6 lifecycle.js:351 `'draft'`→`'never'`: 458/425/14/19 'Image asc-review-as49-priya-mut-f6-test Built'. e2e red set {E1 step 9 (409 AmountMismatchError: reconcile), E2, E3, E4} + invoices.test.js {send-from-edit, R6, R9, R10, R11, R12, R13, R15, R22, R25}. Not run by me: F1–F5, F7–F11, F10b, F-NET, F-ALLOW, F-REPLAY, F-SHAPE, F-V2 (Lena's record: 16/16 red); no mutation in the contract service.

FLOOR CHECK (labelled as such — the sweep, after the findings). Cardinality: 6 cases E0–E5, 21 numbered criteria AC-1..AC-21 examined, plus 5 property claims.
AC-1 E0: 9 = 9, set-equal — pass (green in receipt; F-ALLOW not re-run by me). AC-2: DEVIATES as R1 (303 for 200), documented — pass on property. AC-3, AC-4: pass (E1 green; F2/F3 not re-run). AC-5: pass — syncedAt = READY_AT literal 2026-09-10T00:28:40Z, push then pull, 2 account reads. AC-6, AC-7: pass (client-name count asserted as "once outside the description", measured 2 — the assertion says what it means). AC-8: pass (zero calls). AC-9: pass; F6 red observed by me at step 9. AC-10: pass (exactly one call; sentAt unchanged by the event). AC-11: pass (PAID_AT literal). AC-12: pass (deepEqual incl. updatedAt). AC-13: pass; F12 red observed by me at step 12.
